failure_modes.needed_instead: Explicit validation step after tool execution comparing reported answer against tool stdout; agent must display both raw computation output and final extracted value for independent verification before submission

success_habits.description: Agent systematically breaks numeric problems into sequential computational steps using Python tools—delegating factorial computation, digit summation, modular arithmetic, and binary manipulation to code rather than manual calculation
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Without tool-based computational delegation, agent would rely on manual arithmetic reasoning for large-number operations; errors in digit summation, modular reduction, and factorial evaluation would propagate unchecked to final answers, causing systematic failures across numeric task families

success_habits.description: When tool output contradicts prior reasoning, agent prioritizes the computed value and updates its answer accordingly, treating tool output as authoritative ground truth rather than rationalizing discrepancies away
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Agent would persist with incorrect initial reasoning despite having corrected tool output available; system prompt directive to use 'only the actual results from executed code' is load-bearing for overriding incorrect prior beliefs; its removal would allow rationalization to prevent adoption of corrected computed values
